description:
The main feature of this app is goals.
Tap a goal to start a timer with the remaining time for that goal.
Timer is running all the time, 24/7, even for sleep or breakfast. No stop option! To stop the current goal, you have to start the next one.
You can add a checklist for goals. Useful for morning/evening routines, work, exercises, etc.
This way I control my time and don't forget anything.
Try to adapt it to your life.
Best regards,
Ivan
